notes: Case-insensitive WORD-BOUNDARY phrase match on title+description (so 'died' will not match 'studied'). Drop any video that matches. Two groups: drift/distress terms (news, loss, urgency) and promo/behind-the-scenes terms (institutional content that isn't a wholesome animal clip). Keep this list conservative — over-filtering silently shrinks the feed, so prefer specific multi-word phrases ('conservation partnership') over broad single words ('conservation'). Blank keywords are rejected by the build. Every drop is logged (run with --dry-run) so tuning is evidence-based.
